examples.en: Since yesterday my belly hurts and my stomach is uncomfortable too.
When my stomach burns, I eat porridge.
I had a stomach exam at the hospital.
My stomach is weak, but my legs are strong.

examples.ko: 빈속에 커피를 마시면 위에 부담이 가요.
examples.en: Drinking coffee on an empty stomach puts strain on your stomach.
Warm water is good for the stomach.

explain: 몸속 장기인 '위'는 병원이나 건강 이야기에서 자주 나와요. 일상에서는 '배가 아프다, 속이 안 좋다, 속이 쓰리다'처럼 '배'나 '속'으로 말하는 경우가 많아요. 위쪽(up, above)의 '위'와 글자가 같아서 '위가 아프다'처럼 몸 이야기면 stomach예요.

phrases.en: I ate something spicy, so my stomach burns.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the stomach feels a burning pain.

explain_en: As an organ, '위' appears often in hospital and health talk. In daily life people often say '배가 아프다', '속이 안 좋다' or '속이 쓰리다' using '배' or '속'. It is spelled like 위 (up, above), so in body talk like '위가 아프다' it means stomach.
